threads.body: Towncrier is configured with `wrap = true`, so fragment entries should be a single logical line (avoid manual hard-wrapping). Also, prefer the canonical operation spelling `execute_tool` over `execute-tool` in the fragment text.

`gen_ai.tool.name` and `gen_ai.tool.type` are sampling-relevant for `gen_ai.execute_tool` spans, so they should be provided at span creation time (via the `attributes=` argument to `start_as_current_span`) rather than being set after the span has started.

threads.body: With `gen_ai.tool.name` / `gen_ai.tool.type` now marked sampling-relevant for `gen_ai.execute_tool`, reference scenarios that emit `execute_tool` spans should pass these attributes in the `attributes=` dict at span creation time (not via `set_attribute` after the span starts). Several existing scenarios (e.g., `reference/scenarios/autogen/scenario.py`) currently set these after span start and should be updated for consistency with the sampling-relevant guidance.
